caption:
That drawer of mismatched throw pillows isn't going to fix itself.

Faded covers, flat corduroy, colors that clash with everything else in the room — swapping them out is one of the easiest refreshes for a couch or bed.

This set of 4 sage green boho farmhouse covers is 18x18 inch and sits at 4.6 stars across 3,203 reviews, with a soft corduroy nordic look built for spring updates.

At $16.99 for the set, it's an easy way to give a couch or bedroom a fresh, coordinated look without replacing the pillows themselves.
